text:
According to the onboarding guide, in-tree additions are not supported. Instead, custom tools must be created as standalone plugins:

1. Place your custom tool plugin inside the `~/.hermes/plugins/` directory.
2. Enable it by running:
   ```bash
   hermes plugins enable <name>
   ```

You can also run `hermes tools` to manage/view available tools or run `hermes doctor` to check your configuration and environment.
